title: Bar Drop Sakura Grape 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Sakura Grape by Drop is a sophisticated floral fruit blend. It begins with the taste of dark, sweet grape, providing a juicy and robust inhale. As the flavour develops, it introduces subtle, aromatic notes of cherry blossom (Sakura) on the exhale, adding a delicate floral dimension that elevates the grape base. Mixed at a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid is engineered for high-definition flavour. The higher PG content ensures that the delicate floral notes are not lost against the sweet grape. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping, the nicotine salt blend offers a gentle throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
